I’m a fullstack software engineer with broad expertise in other fields like game development and AI engineering building autonomous agents. I started building for the web in high school, graduated from my undergraduate program in 2026, and now spend most of my time between fullstack platforms and AI engineering.

My sweet spot is the seam between great interfaces and intelligent backends. I like when a UI feels like it’s reading your mind — usually because there’s an agent or a carefully tuned automation doing real work under the hood.

Outside of client work and studies, I build small games, reverse- engineer design details I like, and run little automation experiments to see how much of my own life I can delegate.

Operating principles

  • / 01

    Craft is a product feature.

    Polish, motion and typography aren’t decoration — they’re the reason users trust and stay.

  • / 02

    Agents over screens.

    The next decade of software is autonomous. I build systems that plan and act, not just show data.

  • / 03

    Ship, then ship again.

    Small, focused increments beat big bangs. Velocity is a discipline.

  • / 04

    Learn loudly.

    Curiosity compounds. Mobile, web, games and AI all feed each other.
